name: frontend-audit-reconciliation
body: The spec's frontend containers cover go, java, py, and ts; rust-frontend joins them alongside cpp, csharp, and md, since the graph lacks a rust-frontend container. CI pins JDK 21 and dotnet 10.0.x through actions/setup-java and actions/setup-dotnet, and the formulae use unversioned `depends_on` for every toolchain, so the pin requirement covers CI plus the formula/installer build paths. The vendored tree-sitter records only ABI v15 (zero release version), so `frontend-engine-pin` records it. Confirmed against the graph: `go.apg/gofrontend.discoverModulesViaGoList` runs `go list -m`; `rust.apg-rustfrontend.load_project` discovers the sysroot and runs build scripts; `java.CallGraphBuilder.main` uses `ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler`; the csharp scanner is self-contained; and `rust.pyfrontend.detect_project_kind` is marker-only.
